restaurant_name: บ้านฟันมีนบุรี
text: The female doctor who comes on Saturdays and Sundays, speaks nicely but treats patients very carelessly. I have a small amount of tartar because the doctor only charged me 900. While scraping, he used the tip of the P5 tool to scratch my lower lip until it was wounded, but the doctor chose to lie and say it was a mirror. Don't you want free medicine? I want the truth more. Plus, he doesn't use sickel to keep track of the details. The scraping isn't clean. There are still plaques on the front teeth. He's very careless. I won't feel hurt at all by the careless words that he uses without even apologizing.
